how many applications landed per outreach school when we match names even if written a bit differently, show every school including those with zero

```sql
WITH outreach_schools AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(LOWER("School Name")) AS normalized_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "School Name") AS school_count
  FROM lpf_outreach
  GROUP BY TRIM(LOWER("School Name"))
),
applications_schools AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(LOWER("School")) AS normalized_name,
    COUNT(*) AS application_count
  FROM lpf_applications
  GROUP BY TRIM(LOWER("School"))
),
all_schools AS (
  SELECT normalized_name
  FROM outreach_schools
  UNION
  SELECT normalized_name
  FROM applications_schools
)
SELECT
  o."School Name" AS school_name,
  COALESCE(a.application_count, 0) AS applications_landed,
  COALESCE(o.school_count, 0) AS outreach_count,
  COALESCE(a.application_count, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(o.school_count, 0), 0) AS applications_per_outreach
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT "School Name" FROM lpf_outreach
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT "School" FROM lpf_applications
) s
LEFT JOIN outreach_schools o ON TRIM(LOWER(s."School Name" OR s."School")) = o.normalized_name
LEFT JOIN applications_schools a ON TRIM(LOWER(s."School Name" OR s."School")) = a.normalized_name
ORDER BY s."School Name" OR s."School";
```
